reason: Resolve the preregistered but previously non-numeric under-budget allowance and candidate aggregation without changing the frozen grid.
under_budget_allowance: For each dataset and candidate, the one-sided 95% Wilson upper confidence bound over audit query x ordered-source-target cells must be <= delta.
candidate_unit: One globally fixed (sentinel_n, delta) pair, aggregated uniformly over all preregistered ordered source-target pairs; no per-dataset, per-seed, or per-history selection.
candidate_pass: Wilson upper under-budget bound <= delta on every dataset
target Oracle headroom retention > 0.20 on at least two datasets
including calibration NDC, net NDC improvement > 0.01 versus fixed ef at N=100000 or a larger preregistered workload
p95 online NDC does not exceed fixed-ef p95
direction is consistent across all three realistic histories
direction is not dominated by one seed
decision_priority: AUTHORIZE_CERTIFIED_REBUILD_CALIBRATION if any globally fixed candidate passes all criteria
LIMITED_TO_RELAXED_RISK_REGIME if passes exist only at delta=0.05
KEEP_BOUNDARY_STUDY_CERTIFICATION_IS_COSTLY if at least one candidate meets safety and Recall criteria but no candidate has required net benefit
